verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a document-ingestion and transformation platform (partitioning, chunking, enrichment, extraction) that agents call, not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official Transform MCP server that other AI tools connect to. That server-side capability belongs to a separate story and is not credited here.
